description_full: NovoCure Limited, an oncology company, engages in the development, manufacture, and commercialization of tumor treating fields (TTFields) devices for the treatment of solid tumor cancers in the United States, Germany, France, Japan, Greater China, and internationally. Its TTFields devices include Optune Gio, Optune Lua, and Optune Pax. The company also has ongoing clinical trials investigating TTFields in brain metastases, gastric cancer, glioblastoma, liver cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, and ovarian cancer. NovoCure Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Baar, Switzerland.

financial_summary: NovoCure Limited is a small-cap healthcare business with a $1.4B market cap on $655M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years and +35% annually across the full decade, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at -29% against a 11% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 75% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $76M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, thin -6.9× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 0.3% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and stock-based comp at 16% of revenue is silent dilution an owner has to account for, and insiders hold 9.9% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
